title: Patternmakers, Wood
description: Plan, lay out, and construct wooden unit or sectional patterns used in forming sand molds for castings.

tasks.text: Read blueprints, drawings, or written specifications to determine sizes and shapes of patterns and required machine setups.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Blueprint setup reading partial, human confirms

dwas.name: Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.

tasks.text: Fit, fasten, and assemble wood parts together to form patterns, models, or sections, using glue, nails, dowels, bolts, and screws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood assembly requires hands-on fitting and fastening

dwas.name: Assemble wood products.

tasks.text: Lay out patterns on wood stock and draw outlines of units, sectional patterns, or full-scale mock-ups of products, based on blueprint specifications and sketches, and using marking and measuring devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Trim, smooth, and shape surfaces, and plane, shave, file, scrape, and sand models to attain specified shapes, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Shape surfaces or edges of wood workpieces.
Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Divide patterns into sections according to shapes of castings to facilitate removal of patterns from molds.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Sequence planning aided; production constraints human-verified

dwas.name: Plan production or operational procedures or sequences.

tasks.text: Verify dimensions of completed patterns, using templates, straightedges, calipers, or protractors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Correct patterns to compensate for defects in castings.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Generates template designs; aesthetic fit needs human review

dwas.name: Design templates or patterns.

tasks.text: Set up, operate, and adjust a variety of woodworking machines such as bandsaws and lathes to cut and shape sections, parts, and patterns, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.
Operate woodworking equipment.

tasks.text: Finish completed products or models with shellac, lacquer, wax, or paint.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Estimate costs for patternmaking jobs.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost estimation from inputs; human validates

dwas.name: Estimate costs of products, services, or materials.

tasks.text: Mark identifying information such as colors or codes on patterns, parts, and templates to indicate assembly methods.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Repair broken or damaged patterns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual shaping and fitting of physical templates and molds

dwas.name: Repair templates, patterns, or molds.

tasks.text: Maintain pattern records for reference.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Glue fillets along interior angles of patterns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical construction of templates and work aids

dwas.name: Construct patterns, templates, or other work aids.

tasks.text: Construct wooden models, templates, full scale mock-ups, jigs, or molds for shaping parts of products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mold building is hands-on craft work

dwas.name: Build production molds.

tasks.text: Compute dimensions, areas, volumes, and weights.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Dimension calculations from given specs

dwas.name: Calculate dimensions of workpieces, products, or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Select lumber to be used for patterns.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Select production input materials.

tasks.text: Collect and store patterns and lumber.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Inventory equipment and supplies, ordering parts and tools as necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.
Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Issue patterns to designated machine operators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically delivering supplies to workers

dwas.name: Distribute supplies to workers.
